rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's noble name opens generosity to believers; the mighty name remains beyond the reach of all who seek to find it.
rows.anchor: ^ ( بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ) ^ ' بسم الله ' اسم كريم بسط للمؤمنين بساط جوده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God cannot be comprehended through time or place, and humans know and remember Him only through Him.
rows.anchor: من الذي يعرفه إلا وبه يعرفه ؟ ومن الذي يذكره إلا وبه يذكره ؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The passage was revealed about the blind Ibn Umm Maktum, who arrived while the Prophet spoke with al-Abbas and Umayya ibn Khalaf, hoping they would believe; the Prophet did not interrupt them, turned away, and frowned.
rows.anchor: نزلت في ابن أم مكتوم ، وكان ضريرا . . أتى النبي وكان عنده العباس بن عبد المطلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A tafsir report says the Prophet followed Ibn Umm Maktum and sent someone to find him afterward.
rows.anchor: وجاء في التفسير : أن النبي خرج على أثره ، وأمر بطلبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The same tafsir account says the Prophet thereafter honored Ibn Umm Maktum and appointed him to govern Medina twice.
rows.anchor: وكان بعد ذلك يبره ويكرمه ، فاستخلفه على المدينة مرتين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A tafsir report says that after this the Prophet never frowned at or turned away from a poor person.
rows.anchor: وجاء في التفسير : أنه لم يعبس - بعد هذا - في وجه فقير قط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The address is tactful: it does not confront Ibn Umm Maktum directly, but speaks of him indirectly.
rows.anchor: ويقال : في الخطاب لطف . . . وهو أنه لم يواجهه بل قاله على الكناية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one seeking guidance may be purified by remembering what he learns from the Prophet.
rows.anchor: أي يتذكر بما يتعلم منك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The seeker may take admonition, so that the reminder benefits him.
rows.anchor: أو يذكر فتنفعه الذكرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One who feels self-sufficient in himself has thereby become self-sufficient from God.
rows.anchor: أما من استغنى عن نفسه فإنه استغنى عن الله

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: An alternative gloss takes the self-sufficient person to be one who has become wealthy through his property.
rows.anchor: ويقال : استغنى بما له فأنت له تصدى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: To attend to him means to turn one's face toward him.
rows.anchor: فأنت له تصدى ، أي تقبل عليه بوجهك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet is not answerable if the other man is not purified; his duty is only to convey the message.
rows.anchor: فأنت لا تؤخذ بألا يتزكى هو فإنما عليك البلاغ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The man who comes eagerly to seek knowledge and fears God is neglected while the Prophet turns elsewhere and occupies himself with others.
rows.anchor: يسعى } . لطلب العلم ، ويخشى الله فأنت عنه تتلهى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The whole passage is a reproach directed to the Prophet on behalf of the poor.
rows.anchor: وهذا كله من قبيل العتاب معه لأجل الفقراء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an is a reminder; whom God wills to remember does so, and whom He wills not to remember does not, in accordance with the decree and God's will.
rows.anchor: فمن شاء الله أن يذكره ذكره ، ومن شاء الله ألا يذكره لم يذكره ؛ أي بذلك جرى القضاء

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Alternatively, the wording is a threat: whoever wishes may remember it, and whoever wishes may refuse, as in the challenge about believing or disbelieving.
rows.anchor: ويقال : الكلام على جهة التهديد ؛ ومعناه : فمن أراد أن يذكره فليذكره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The masculine pronoun in “remember it” is used because it refers to the Qur'an; the author did not use the feminine form.
rows.anchor: وقال سبحانه : { ذكره } ولم يقل ( ذكرها ) لأنه أراد به القرآن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The honored pages are the scriptures of Abraham, Moses, and those before them, and the Preserved Tablet.
rows.anchor: أي صحف إبراهيم وموسى وما قبل ذلك ، وفي اللوح المحفوظ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pages are elevated in rank and purified from contradiction and falsehood.
rows.anchor: مرفوعة في القدر والرتبة ، مطهرة من التناقض والكذب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The “scribes” are the recording angels.
rows.anchor: بأيدى سفرة } . أي : الملائكة الكتبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels are noble with God and obediently righteous.
rows.anchor: كرام بررة } . كرام عند الله بررة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase means, “Cursed be man”: how great his disbelief is.
rows.anchor: لعن الإنسان ما أعظم كفره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God created, formed, and proportioned the human being through successive stages: a drop, then a clot, then stage after stage.
rows.anchor: خلقه وصوره وقدره أطوارا : من نطفة ، ثم علقة ، ثم طورا بعد طور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God made the path easy in both good and evil and inspired the human being in how to act.
rows.anchor: يسر عليه السبيل في الخير والشر ، وألهمه كيف التصرف

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: An alternative reading is that God made birth easy, so the child emerges from the womb head first and upside down.
rows.anchor: ويقال : يسر عليه الخروج من بطن أمه يخرج أولا رأسه منكوسا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God provided a grave so beasts and birds would not devour the dead person and expose him to disgrace.
rows.anchor: جعل له قبرا لئلا تفترسه السباع والطيور ولئلا يفتضح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God will raise the person from his grave.
rows.anchor: ثم إذا شآء أنشره } . بعثه من قبره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The person has not fulfilled what he was commanded to do; he has disobeyed and opposed the command.
rows.anchor: أي : عصى وخالف ما أمر به

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Alternatively, God did not decree that the person fulfill His command; had He decreed it for him, he would not have disobeyed.
rows.anchor: ويقال : لم يقض الله له ما أمره به ، ولو قضى عليه وله ما أمره به لما عصاه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the inward reading, God pours the water of mercy onto hardened hearts, softening them for repentance.
rows.anchor: صببنا ماء الرحمة على القلوب القاسية فلانت للتوبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God pours the water of gnosis on hearts, from which flowers of unity and lights of spiritual stripping grow.
rows.anchor: وصببنا ماء التعريف على القلوب فنبتت أزهار التوحيد وأنوار التجريد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Qadb” means al-qatt, a fodder plant.
rows.anchor: { وقضبا } أي القت . { وحدآئق غلبا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Ghulb” gardens are dense and robust.
rows.anchor: وحدآئق غلبا } متكاثفة غلاظا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Fakiha” is a collective term for fruits, while “abba” means pasture.
rows.anchor: وفاكهة وأبا } . الفاكهة : جمع الفواكه ، و { وأبا } : المرعى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “The deafening blast” means the Resurrection.
rows.anchor: فإذا جآءت الصآخة } أي : القيامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People flee their close relatives at the Resurrection because each has a pressing concern that leaves no time for another.
rows.anchor: لكل امرىء منهم يومئذ شأن يغنيه } . لا يتفرغ إلى ذاك ، ولا ذاك إلى هذه

rows.speaker: قالوا
rows.claim: The Sufis say uprightness is to experience the present moment as a Resurrection.
rows.anchor: كذلك قالوا : الاستقامة أن تشهد الوقت قيامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every saint or knower inwardly flees today from family and children; the gnostic remains among people while separating from them in his heart.
rows.anchor: فما من ولي ولا عارف إلا وهو - اليوم - بقلبه يفر من أخيه وأمه وأبيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A poem illustrates the gnostic's inward attachment to the beloved while making his body available to whoever wishes to sit with him.
rows.anchor: فلقد جعلتك في الفؤاد محدثي . . . وأبحت جسمي من أراد جلوسي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some rejoicing faces rejoice because they have reached Paradise.
rows.anchor: فمنهم من استبشاره لوصوله إلى جنته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some rejoice because they have reached the houris, their allotted delight.
rows.anchor: ومنهم لوصوله إلى الحور العين من حظيته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some rejoice because they have looked upon their Lord and seen Him.
rows.anchor: وبعضهم لأنه نظر إلى ربه فرآه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The dust covering those faces is the dust of the wicked.
rows.anchor: وهي غبرة الفساق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gloom that overtakes those faces is the humiliation of being veiled.
rows.anchor: ترهقها قترة } . وهي ذل الحجاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When God wills to exalt a servant, He leads him to gnosis, adorns and chooses him, protects him from disobedience, guides him through every state, receives him in faith, settles him in Paradise, and completes grace with vision.
rows.anchor: عزيز إذاأراد إعزاز عبد وقفه لعرفانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God swears by the heaven and by the star that arrives at night.
rows.anchor: أقسم بالسماء ، وبالنجم الذي يطرق ليلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question magnifies the importance of the star.
rows.anchor: استفهام يراد منه تفخيم شأن هذا النجم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The piercing star is bright and elevated.
rows.anchor: النجم الثاقب } . المضيء العالي

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One reported interpretation identifies it as a star hurled at the devils.
rows.anchor: وقيل : الذي ترمى به الشياطين

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: An inward interpretation takes the stars as stars of gnosis that indicate divine unity and guide people of insight by their light.
rows.anchor: ويقال : هي نجوم المعرفة التي تدل على التوحيد يستضيء بنورها

words: إن كل نفس لما عليها حافظ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every soul has a guardian angel who preserves its deeds, provision, and lifespan, and prompts constant alertness and careful self-keeping.
rows.anchor: ما من نفس إلا عليها حافظ من الملائكة ، يحفظ عمله ورزقه وأجله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gushing fluid comes from the father's loins and the mother's nurturing.
rows.anchor: يخرج من صلب الأب ، وتربية الأم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reflection on human origin urges inference to God's complete power, knowledge, and will.
rows.anchor: يحثه على النظر والاستدلال حتى يعرف كمال قدرته وعلمه وإرادته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is able to resurrect and recreate the human being.
rows.anchor: إنه على بعثه ، وخلقه مرة أخرى لقادر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since God's power is perfect, power over a thing entails power over its like, and resurrection is equivalent in meaning to origination.
rows.anchor: والقدرة على الشيء تقتضي القدرة على مثله ، والإعادة في معنى الابتداء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On that day the inner secrets are tested.
rows.anchor: يوم تبلى السرائر } . يوم تمتحن الضمائر

words: فما له من قوة ولا ناصر
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The human being then has no helper to repel God's judgment.
rows.anchor: ما لهذا الإنسان - يومئذ - من معين يدفع عنه حكم الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sky's “return” means rain.
rows.anchor: والسماء ذات الرجع } . أي المطر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The land's cleaving is its splitting open with vegetation for crops and trees.
rows.anchor: والأرض ذات الصدع } . ( الصدع ) : الانشقاق بالنبات للزرع والشجر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an is a decisive, unambiguous statement.
rows.anchor: إنه لقول فصل } . أي : إن القرآن لقول جزم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an is not falsehood or play; jest is the opposite of seriousness.
rows.anchor: وما هو بالهزل } . الهزل ضد الجد ، فليس القرآن بباطل ولا لعب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disbelievers scheme and plot.
rows.anchor: إنهم يكيدون كيدا } . أي يحتالون حيلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God responds to their plotting by decreeing and creating, repaying them through gradual entrapment and respite.
rows.anchor: ونحن نحكم فعلا ونبرم خلقا ، ونجازيهم على كيدهم ، بما نعاملهم به من الاستدراج والإمهال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command means to leave the disbelievers and give them a short, gentle respite.
rows.anchor: أي أنظرهم ، وأمهلهم قليلا ، وأرودهم رويدا
